messages.subject: stat_contour and geom_tile problem
parts:
Hi,

I have a problem drawing stat_contour around some specific area in the geom_tile plot

the problem is that the stat_contour lines are being drawn in a weird way around the areas that i want in the geom_tile (e. g the area should correspond to a group of small boxes in the geom_tile but the stat_contour is drawing the lines sometimes in the middle of the box or only considering half or third of some boxes)

i generated the plot using this code: in case someone wants to check the details


newdf= read.table("table1.txt", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

errorplot=ggplot(newdf) + geom_tile(aes(fill=error,X,Y))+ scale_fill_gradient(low="yellow", high="red")
 
errorplot <- errorplot + theme_bw(base_size = 40)  + coord_fixed()+scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,l,1000), labels=seq(0,16,1),'Y-axis', expand=c(0.03,0.03)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,l,1000),labels=seq(0,16,1), 'X-axis',expand=c(0.03,0.03))+ opts(legend.key.height=unit(5,"line"))+ opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(size=40))

errorplot = errorplot + stat_contour(breaks=c(0.001,0.01,0.05),aes(x=X,y=Y,z=sign,colour = ..level..)) + scale_colour_gradient(low = "green",medium="black", high = "blue") 


 so is it possible to draw the stat_contour around the areas which have a specific value in a nice way and not lines that cover exactly the boxes which are considered without cutting half or third of the geom_tile small boxes ??


Regards,
